description: A5b K=3 extended beta-sweep with G_egemaps_full (full 88-d eGeMAPSv02) as a candidate third group. Two configs: A = K=2 replacement (A2+G4_gi+G_egemaps_full) vs current K=2 LOCKED (A2+G4_gi+G5_mod) at 0.7037; B = K=3 addition (A2+G4_gi+G5_mod+G_egemaps_full). Per-seed argmax beta* lock with extended grid {0..2, 2.5..16}. 5 seeds. ADMIT K=3 if mean UAR > K=2 LOCKED + 0.005 = 0.7087.
